lines.text: The lab printer is jammed again.
I can clear it, but the queue is long.
I only need two pages for class.
Then use the printer by the stairs.
Does it take the same card?
Yes. Swipe once and choose black and white.
Good. I'll go before the seminar.
If the card fails, tell the desk.

questions.q: Why does the woman need another printer?
options: The lab printer is jammed and the queue is long.
questions.why: Ela diz que a impressora do laboratório emperrou, e ele avisa que a fila está longa.

questions.q: What will the woman do next?
options: Print by the stairs before the seminar
Ask the man to clear the jam
questions.why: Ela decide ir à impressora da escada antes do seminário.

lines.text: Did you reserve a study room for tonight?
I tried. The only open slot is at ten.
That's late. I have a shift at six in the morning.
We could use the empty classroom in Harper.
Is it unlocked after eight?
The night guard opens it if a class is listed.
Our review isn't a class.
Then let's take the ten o'clock room and stop at midnight.

questions.q: What problem do the students have?
options: The only study room is very late.
Harper Hall is closed all week.
The man does not want to review.
questions.why: A única sala livre é às dez, e o homem trabalha de manhã cedo.

questions.q: What do they decide?
options: To ask the guard to pretend they have a class
To use the ten o'clock room and finish at midnight
To meet at six in the morning
questions.why: A mulher propõe a sala das dez e parar à meia-noite, e a conversa fecha nesse plano.

lines.text: Are you still selling the desk lamp?
Yes. It's in my room in Cedar.
Can I see it after dinner?
Dinner is fine. Bring cash. I don't have change.
Is fifteen the final price?
Yes, and the bulb is new.
I'll come at seven.
Text me if the front door is locked.

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to bring?
questions.why: Ele diz para ela trazer dinheiro porque não tem troco.

questions.q: What will the woman do?
questions.why: Ela diz que chegará às sete.

lines.text: Professor Shah said my graph has no units.
Then the trend is hard to read.
I used centimeters, but I never wrote them.
Add the unit to the axis and to the caption.
Will she still accept it after the deadline?
She gave you until Friday for corrections only.
So I should not change the conclusion.
Right. Fix the labels and resubmit the same file.

questions.q: What is wrong with the man's graph?
questions.why: Ele usou centímetros, mas não os escreveu, e a professora apontou a falta de unidades.

questions.q: What should he do by Friday?
options: Fix the labels and resubmit the same file
questions.why: A mulher diz para corrigir os rótulos e reenviar o mesmo arquivo.

lines.text: The shuttle driver skipped our stop.
He only stops if someone signals.
I didn't know that.
Wave before the corner, not after.
Is there another bus in the next hour?
The night line can send a car if you call.
I have the number on my card.
Call now. They get busy after ten.

questions.q: Why did the shuttle skip the stop?
questions.why: O homem explica que o ônibus só para se alguém sinalizar.

questions.q: What does the man advise the woman to do?
questions.why: Ele diz para ligar agora porque depois das dez o serviço fica cheio.

lines.text: I can't find the sign-up sheet for the trip.
It's on the board outside the office.
The board was empty this morning.
I moved the sheet to the counter.
Is there still room?
Two seats, but you need a packed lunch.
I can bring a sandwich.
Then write your name before noon.

questions.q: Where is the sign-up sheet now?
questions.why: A mulher diz que mudou a lista para o balcão.

questions.q: What must the man do to get a seat?
options: Bring a packed lunch and sign before noon
questions.why: Ainda há dois lugares se ele levar lanche e escrever o nome antes do meio-dia.

lines.text: My group partner hasn't answered in a week.
Did you try the course forum?
Yes. He read the message and didn't reply.
Then tell the professor before the draft is due.
I don't want to get him in trouble.
You can report the missing work without judging him.
The draft is Thursday.
Write tonight and attach the dates you contacted him.

questions.q: What has the partner done?
options: He read the message but did not reply.
questions.why: A mulher diz que ele leu a mensagem e não respondeu.

questions.q: What does the man suggest she include?
options: A judgment of the partner's character
The dates she tried to contact him
A new topic for the draft
questions.why: Ele pede que ela anexe as datas em que tentou contato.

lines.text: The housing office offered me a room on the noisy side.
You can refuse it once without losing your place in line.
I didn't see that in the email.
It's in the second paragraph, after the floor plan.
If I refuse, when is the next offer?
Usually within ten days, but the rent may be higher.
Higher by how much?
They don't say. Ask before you click refuse.

questions.q: What can the man do once?
options: Refuse the room without losing his place
questions.why: A mulher diz que ele pode recusar uma vez sem perder o lugar na fila.

questions.q: What does the woman imply he should do before refusing?
options: Ask how much higher the rent may be
questions.why: Ela diz que o valor maior não está no e-mail e que ele deve perguntar antes de recusar.

lines.text: Do you have a minute to look at my poster?
I have ten minutes before lab.
The title is too long.
Cut it to one line and enlarge the photo.
Will people still know the topic?
The first sentence under the photo can explain it.
I'll print a new copy tonight.
Use the matte paper. Glossy reflects the lights.

questions.q: What change does the man recommend first?
options: A one-line title and a larger photo
questions.why: Ele manda cortar o título para uma linha e aumentar a foto.

questions.q: Why does he prefer matte paper?
questions.why: Ele explica que o papel brilhante reflete as luzes.

lines.text: The clinic canceled my appointment.
Did they offer a new time?
Only next month. My form is due Friday.
Ask for a nurse visit. Those are shorter.
Will a nurse visit stamp the form?
Yes, if the form is a fitness clearance.
It is.
Call before noon. The afternoon slots go first.

questions.q: Why is the man worried about the cancellation?
options: His form is due Friday and the new time is next month.
questions.why: A nova consulta é só no mês que vem, mas o formulário vence na sexta.

questions.q: What should he do before noon?
options: Call and ask for a nurse visit
questions.why: A mulher diz para ligar antes do meio-dia porque os horários da tarde acabam primeiro.

lines.text: I'm bringing soup to the floor dinner.
Great. I'll bring bread.
Can you also get paper bowls?
The shop under the dorm has them.
Get twenty. We are more people this week.
I'll go after class.
Leave them in the kitchen, not in your room.
Will do.

questions.q: What will the man contribute?
questions.why: Ele traz o pão e aceita comprar as tigelas de papel.

questions.q: Where should he leave the bowls?
questions.why: A mulher pede que ele deixe as tigelas na cozinha.

lines.text: I quoted a paragraph without a page number.
Then the citation is incomplete.
The idea is still mine around it.
The quoted lines still need the source.
The book is at home.
The library has the same edition on reserve.
Is the page the same in every printing?
Use the edition on the syllabus, not a different one.

questions.q: What is missing from the man's paper?
options: A page number for a quotation
questions.why: Ele citou um parágrafo sem o número da página.

questions.q: Which edition should he use?
options: The edition listed on the syllabus
No edition, because the idea is his
questions.why: A mulher manda usar a edição do plano de ensino, não outra.

lines.text: The club vote is tied.
Then the president can break the tie.
She left early.
In that case the vote is held again next week.
Can we campaign before then?
Yes, but no posters in the library.
I'll send one email to the members.
Keep it short. Long emails get skipped.

questions.q: Why will the vote be held again?
options: The vote is tied and the president left.
questions.why: O voto empatou e a presidente, que desempataria, já tinha ido embora.

questions.q: What restriction does the man mention?
questions.why: Ele permite a campanha, mas proíbe cartazes na biblioteca.

lines.text: Is the museum trip still on Saturday?
Yes, but we meet at the side gate, not the front.
What time?
Nine. The tickets are timed for nine-thirty.
Can I pay on the bus?
No. Pay the treasurer tonight.
I'll find her after choir.
She leaves the practice room at eight.

questions.q: Where will the group meet?
questions.why: A mulher corrige o ponto de encontro para o portão lateral.

questions.q: When can the man pay the treasurer?
options: After choir, before she leaves at eight
questions.why: Ele vai procurá-la depois do coral, e ela sai da sala às oito.

lines.text: My laptop died in the middle of the quiz file.
Did it save to the course folder?
I was working offline.
Then the lab computers may not have it.
I have an older version on my drive.
Submit that tonight and explain the crash.
Will the professor accept a note?
She has, when the note arrives before midnight.

questions.q: Why is the newest file missing from the lab computers?
questions.why: Ela estava sem conexão, então a pasta do curso não recebeu o arquivo.

questions.q: What does the man recommend?
options: Wait until morning with no note
Submit the older version tonight and explain
questions.why: Ele manda enviar a versão antiga ainda hoje e explicar a falha.

lines.text: The landlord says guests can stay only one night.
Your parents are coming for three.
I don't want to hide them.
Ask for a written exception before they arrive.
What if he says no?
Then book them the guest flat the university keeps for families.
Is it expensive?
Less than a hotel, and it is two stops away.

questions.q: What rule creates the problem?
options: Guests may stay only one night.
The landlord lives two stops away.
questions.why: O proprietário limita hóspedes a uma noite, e os pais ficam três.

questions.q: What is the backup plan if the landlord refuses?
options: Move to a hotel farther away without asking
questions.why: A mulher sugere o apartamento de hóspedes da universidade se ele disser não.

lines.text: You left your notebook in the seminar room.
The blue one?
Yes. I gave it to the department assistant.
Is the office still open?
Until four.
I have class until four.
She said she can leave it at the front desk.
Please ask her to. I'll pick it up at five.

questions.q: Where is the notebook now?
questions.why: A mulher entregou o caderno azul à assistente do departamento.

questions.q: What will happen so the man can collect it at five?
options: The assistant will be asked to leave it at the front desk.
The woman will bring it to class.
questions.why: Como a aula vai até as quatro, ele pede que deixem o caderno na recepção.

lines.text: The experiment needs ice, and the machine is broken.
The dining hall will give you a bag if you bring a cooler.
I don't have a cooler.
Borrow the one from the field kit.
It's checked out until three.
Then start the warm steps now and get ice later.
The warm steps take an hour.
That's enough time. I'll watch the bench.

questions.q: What is the man unable to get right now?
options: Ice, because the machine is broken and the cooler is out
questions.why: A máquina de gelo quebrou e a caixa térmica está emprestada até as três.

questions.q: What is the plan?
options: Do the warm steps now and get ice later
Use the dining hall as a lab
questions.why: A mulher sugere fazer as etapas que não precisam de gelo e buscá-lo depois.

lines.text: I need a quiet seat for the online exam.
The carrels on the top floor don't allow talking.
Do I need to reserve one?
Yes, for blocks of two hours.
My exam is ninety minutes.
Book two hours so you have time to set up.
I'll book the four o'clock block.
Bring headphones. The timer beeps.

questions.q: Why does the man suggest two hours?
options: She needs time to set up as well as take the exam.
The carrels close at ninety minutes.
questions.why: A prova dura noventa minutos, e ele recomenda duas horas para incluir a preparação.

questions.q: What should the woman bring?
questions.why: Ele avisa que o cronômetro apita e que ela deve levar fones.

lines.text: I think the sample size in the article is too small.
Then be careful how strongly you criticize it.
Twenty people cannot settle the question.
You can say the result is suggestive, not final.
Should I ignore the article?
No. Use it as a limit on your own claim.
So I cite it and name the limit.
Exactly. That is more precise than rejecting it.

questions.q: What is the man's concern?
options: The sample is too small to settle the question.
questions.why: Ele diz que vinte pessoas não bastam para encerrar a questão.

questions.q: What does the woman want him to do with the article?
options: Cite it and state its limit
questions.why: Ela pede que ele use o artigo como limite da própria afirmação, citando esse limite.

lines.text: The rehearsal moved to the choir room.
I went to the auditorium and no one was there.
The message went out at lunch.
I was in lab and didn't see it.
We still need your part before tonight.
I can come at four.
Four works. Bring the marked score.
It's in my locker. I'll get it first.

questions.q: Why did the man miss the rehearsal location?
options: He did not see the lunch message because he was in lab.
questions.why: Ele estava no laboratório e não viu o aviso do almoço.

questions.q: What will he do before coming at four?
options: Get the marked score from his locker
questions.why: Ele diz que a partitura marcada está no armário e que vai buscá-la primeiro.

lines.text: The advisor wants me to add a statistics course.
Does it fit your Tuesday schedule?
Only the evening section is open.
That section has a lab on Thursday.
I work Thursday nights.
Then ask the waitlist for the afternoon section.
Is the waitlist long?
Three people. One usually drops after the first quiz.

questions.q: Why is the evening section a problem?
options: Its Thursday lab conflicts with his work.
questions.why: A seção da noite tem laboratório na quinta, e ele trabalha nesse período.

questions.q: What does the woman imply about the afternoon section?
options: A seat may open because someone often drops after the first quiz.
He should quit his job tonight.
questions.why: Ela diz que há três pessoas na fila e que uma costuma sair depois da primeira prova.

lines.text: I reserved the camera, but the case was empty.
Check the sign-out tablet.
The last name is from the photo club.
They have a shoot until six.
My assignment is due at eight.
Use the backup camera. It is slower in low light.
I can shoot near the windows.
Then you won't need the missing lens.

questions.q: What is wrong with the reserved camera?
questions.why: Ela reservou a câmera, mas o estojo estava vazio.

questions.q: How will she finish the assignment?
options: Wait for the club until after eight
Use the backup camera near the windows
questions.why: Ele oferece a câmera reserva, e ela decide fotografar perto das janelas.

lines.text: I wouldn't say the interview went badly.
So something in it still bothers you.
I couldn't name a project when she asked.
You did the archive project last spring.
I froze and talked about my courses instead.
Send a short note that adds the project, without apologizing for the whole interview.
Will that look like I forgot?
It will look like you followed up. Keep it to one example.

questions.q: What actually went wrong in the interview?
options: He could not name a project and talked about courses instead.
questions.why: Ele travou e falou das disciplinas em vez de citar um projeto.

questions.q: What kind of note does the woman recommend?
options: A short follow-up with one project and no broad apology
A request to repeat the whole interview
questions.why: Ela sugere um recado curto com o projeto, sem pedir desculpas pela entrevista inteira.

lines.text: If the sensor reading is right, the soil is drier than the plants look.
Then the leaves are misleading.
They can stay green for days after the water drops.
Should I water tonight?
Water only the marked beds. The others were irrigated this morning.
I'll record both the reading and the color.
Good. The report should not choose one signal and hide the other.
I'll put them in the same table.

questions.q: What disagreement do the two signals create?
options: The plants look fine, but the sensor says the soil is dry.
questions.why: O sensor indica solo mais seco do que a aparência das plantas sugere.

questions.q: What should the report do?
options: Present both the reading and the color
questions.why: A mulher diz que o relatório não deve escolher um sinal e esconder o outro.

lines.text: Where is the mailroom?
Down the hall, on the left.
Is it open now?
Yes, until five.
I need a stamp.
They sell stamps at the window.
Thanks. I'll go now.
Take your card. They ask for it at the window.

questions.q: Where is the mailroom?
options: Down the hall, on the left
questions.why: A mulher indica o fim do corredor, à esquerda.

questions.q: What must the man take with him?
questions.why: Ela diz que pedem a carteirinha.

lines.text: Can you help me carry these books?
Sure. Where are we going?
To the reserve desk.
That's on this floor.
I know. The stack is heavy.
I'll take the top half.
Thank you.
Set them down. I'll slide them across.

questions.q: What does the woman want?
questions.why: Ela pede ajuda para carregar os livros até o balcão de reserva.

questions.q: What will the man do?
options: Leave the books in the hall
Carry the top half and help slide them
questions.why: Ele fica com a metade de cima e diz que vai empurrá-los no balcão.

lines.text: The group presentation is twelve minutes.
Then we each get about three.
I need four for the map.
I can cut my part if you start on time.
I won't repeat the introduction.
Good. I'll end with the question for the class.
Put that question on the last slide.
I will, in large type.

questions.q: Why does the man want four minutes?
options: To ask the class a question
questions.why: Ele diz que precisa de quatro minutos para o mapa.

questions.q: What will the woman put on the last slide?
questions.why: Ela vai encerrar com a pergunta e colocá-la no último slide.

lines.text: The field trip waiver is missing your signature.
I thought the online box was enough.
The office wants ink on the paper copy too.
Can I sign it in the morning?
Only if you bring it before the bus list closes at nine.
My first class ends at eight-fifty.
Then come straight here. I'll hold the list.
I'll run.

questions.q: What is still required?
options: A signature in ink on the paper copy
questions.why: O escritório quer a assinatura à tinta na cópia em papel.

questions.q: What will the woman do to help?
options: Hold the list if he arrives before nine
questions.why: Ela segura a lista se ele vier direto depois da aula, antes das nove.

lines.text: I cooked rice, but the pot boiled over.
The shared kitchen is sticky now.
I'll clean it before anyone else cooks.
Use the wipes under the sink, not the dish towel.
Should I replace the rice?
People can serve what is left. Just label it.
I'll write the time on the lid.
And move the pot off the hot burner.

questions.q: What problem did the man cause?
options: The pot boiled over and left the kitchen sticky.
He forgot to label the sink.
questions.why: O arroz ferveu e transbordou, e a cozinha ficou grudenta.

questions.q: What should he do with the remaining rice?
options: Dry it with the dish towel
questions.why: Ela diz que o que sobrou pode ser servido, desde que ele identifique e anote a hora.

lines.text: The model fits the average year and misses the dry ones.
So a single score hides the risk we care about.
I can split the graph by rainfall group.
Do that, and don't average the groups back together in the caption.
The caption can state the gap instead.
Yes. Say which group the policy fails.
It fails the driest group.
Then that sentence belongs in the first paragraph, not a footnote.

questions.q: What is the flaw in the model as presented?
options: It fits a typical year but misses dry years.
questions.why: A mulher diz que o modelo acerta o ano médio e erra os anos secos.

questions.q: Where does the man want the key sentence?
questions.why: Ele diz que a frase sobre o grupo mais seco deve ir no primeiro parágrafo.

lines.text: I'm tempted to drop the seminar after the add deadline.
A drop now shows on the record as a withdrawal.
Is that worse than a low grade?
For this course, a withdrawal is cleaner if you are likely to fail.
I might still pass if the last paper goes well.
Then decide after you outline it, not tonight.
The outline will tell me if the sources are enough.
Exactly. Don't withdraw on a mood.

questions.q: What happens if he drops now?
questions.why: Depois do prazo de inclusão, a saída entra no histórico como trancamento.

questions.q: What does the woman want him to do before deciding?
options: Outline the paper and judge the sources
questions.why: Ela manda decidir depois do esboço, não por impulso nesta noite.

lines.text: What time is the movie?
Seven-thirty, in room 5.
Is it free?
Free for students. Others pay two dollars.
I'll bring my card.
Do. They check it at the door.
Save me a seat?
I'll be there at seven and hold a seat.

questions.q: How much do students pay?
questions.why: O homem diz que o filme é gratuito para estudantes.

questions.q: What will the man do?
options: Be there at seven and save her a seat
questions.why: Ele aceita o pedido de lugar ao dizer que chega às sete.

lines.text: I forgot my water bottle.
There is a fountain by the gym.
Is the water safe to drink?
Yes. I fill my bottle there every day.
Can I borrow yours until then?
Take a sip. I'll refill at the fountain with you.
Thanks.
Let's go before class.

questions.q: Where can the man get water?
options: At the fountain by the gym
questions.why: A mulher indica o bebedouro ao lado do ginásio.

questions.q: What will they do next?
options: Go to the fountain before class
questions.why: Ela propõe ir juntos antes da aula, e ele agradece.
